(c) Booking flow end-to-end via UI: /booking/313 -> filled input-first-name/input-last-name/input-whatsapp -> confirm-booking-btn -> 'Réservation confirmée !' with reference ABC399341 + PIN 112050; Réservations tab then shows the booking with header 'Tirez pour actualiser le statut', card testID=booking-1783119278301, colored status badge testID=status-1783119278301 rendering 'En attente' (pending), plus reference + PIN + 147€. No red screen, only cosmetic RN-Web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' / 'props.pointerEvents') persist from previous iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: server.booking_status uses allow_redirects=False and treats a non-200 (typical for wrong booking_number/pin_code on airbcars.ma, which redirects) as not-found -> 404. Correct behavior; STATUS_RE parses the confirmation page span; falls through to 404 if the label isn't present.

bookings.tsx useFocusEffect(loadAndRefresh) refetches on every tab focus, plus RefreshControl on FlatList; both paths call fetchBookingStatus per booking then updateBookingStatus if changed — no unnecessary DB writes when unchanged. Sequencing via Promise.all is fine given per-booking independence.

STATUS_COLORS dictionary maps pending/confirmed/completed/cancelled to badge bg+fg+icon; falls back to 'pending' colors for unknown statuses — safe default. AppText color uses sc.fg (contrast against tinted bg is adequate).
fetchBookingStatus swallows fetch errors returning null so the UI keeps the last known status offline — good resiliency.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — contact form flow, reviews-section rendering (35 cards), and full booking + status-badge flow all verified end-to-end
